operational-example.copy: Use Slider when users adjust a bounded numeric value and need immediate visual feedback.

scenario.title: Route search radius
rationale: Slider is efficient for bounded values where exact typing is not the primary need.
The ZIP reference uses a sunken track, accent fill, white thumb, mono value, and thumb scale/glow on drag.
Use Input when precise numeric entry is required.

items.rule: Shows current value in readable numeric format.
Drag target with focus and active feedback.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, dragging, focus, error, complete, default
items: Use native range semantics or equivalent aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, and aria-valuemax.
Keep value visible outside the thumb.
Do not use Slider for unbounded values.
Pair with Input when exact entry is required.

variants.copy: Slider variants describe numeric behavior: continuous, stepped, bounded, threshold, and paired value.

states.copy: Slider states communicate default, focus, dragging, disabled, error, and completed value.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant defines the range model; state defines interaction and availability.

full-width.copy: Slider may fill its container, but label and value remain visible.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Use larger density on touch devices and preserve visible value in every layout.

viewport-organization.copy: Use Slider in settings, filters, and bounded adjustments. Use Input for precision.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use comfortable touch target and visible value.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use compact sliders in filters with numeric labels.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify label, value, min, max, step, variant, and state.

api-foundations.copy: Slider API exposes value, min, max, step, label, format, disabled, and state while Design System foundations own range semantics, motion, focus, and measurement copy.

props.name: valueLabel
props.notes: Initial display label for the current value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.notes: Called when the local value changes.

props.name: density
props.notes: Context density for touch target and spacing.

props.name: unit
props.notes: Suffix appended to numeric value when no formatter is supplied.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not use for exact money entry alone.
Do not hide min and max meaning.
Do not use for unbounded values.

groups.title: Review
items: Check keyboard increments, value label, focus, disabled, and touch target.

rejectIf: Exact financial entry has no text alternative.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Slider as bounded adjustment: agents may configure ranges when limits are known, but humans confirm units, risk, and precision needs.
canDecide: Use Slider for bounded settings and filters.
Use Input alongside Slider when exact entry matters.
mustAsk: The range affects money, compliance, or permissions.
Min, max, step, or unit is unknown.
The value must be exact rather than approximate.
rejectIf: The range has no defined bounds.
miel.handoff: I am using Slider for bounded adjustment. Please confirm min, max, step, unit, and whether exact input is required.
